semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nissei Corporation operates as a trading company specializing in chemical products, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nissei Corporation is a specialized trading company that focuses on chemical products and has expanded its trading activities to include related products. The company supports globalization and overseas procurement for its customers, particularly in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: Nissei has established corporate bodies and representative offices in major cities including Shanghai and Beijing.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has a representative office to support its operations in Southeast Asia.
regional_presence.Thailand: Nissei has a presence in Bangkok to facilitate regional trading activities.
regional_presence.Vietnam: The company operates in Ho Chi Minh to enhance its market reach in the region.
regional_presence.India: Nissei has a representative office in Gurgaon to assist with local procurement.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company maintains a presence in Taipei to support its business activities.
regional_presence.Korea: Nissei has established a representative office in Pyeongtaek to cater to the Korean market.
regional_presence.United States: The company has a presence in Phoenix to support its North American operations.
